resources.description: The live vike-tradehub's orders, positions, per-venue equity and recent events — the same payload the node_snapshot tool returns, `bars` left out. ⚠ Top-level `positions`, `balance` and `trading_state` are the PRIMARY engine's alone and `equity_total` covers only its currency group, so on a node with several accounts read `venues[].positions` before calling anything flat. Requires --node + VIKE_TRADEHUB_OBSERVE_KEY; reading it is what opens the connection.
